item.title: More Marines and Warships Being Sent to Middle East, U.S. Officials Say
item.summary: Iran’s response to days of aerial bombardment and long-range artillery strikes has proved more resilient than Trump administration officials anticipated.

item.title: U.S.-Made Launcher Fired Missiles From Bahrain Toward Iran, Video Shows
item.summary: It is unclear from the video alone whether the U.S. or Bahraini military launched the missiles. Iran has frequently accused Persian Gulf countries of allowing their territory to be used as a launchpad for U.S. attacks.

item.title: To Fight Iran’s Drones, U.S. Taps Ukraine’s Hard-Earned Knowledge
item.summary: As Iran has shown, warfare involves far more deadly projectiles than it once did. It’s a problem Ukraine has been dealing with for years.

item.title: Israel Drops Leaflets on Beirut with Reminders of Gaza War
item.summary: Leaflets dropped over the capital referenced Israel’s “success in Gaza” and urged Lebanese citizens to disarm Hezbollah.

item.title: Hegseth’s Claim About Killing a Would-Be Assassin Creates a Mystery
item.summary: The defense secretary said the leader of an Iranian unit that had planned to assassinate President Trump had been killed. But U.S. officials privately acknowledge the story is not that simple.

item.title: Hegseth says an officer has been appointed to investigate deadly strike on Iranian school.
U.S. Tech Giants Flocked to the Persian Gulf. Now They Are Targets.
item.summary: Amazon, Google and others struck deals in the Persian Gulf to foot the bill for A.I. development. Iran has now threatened attacks against the companies’ infrastructure in the region.

item.title: Hegseth Vows Lethal Day in Iran as Air War Intensifies
item.summary: At a news conference, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gave no indication of how long it would take before the Navy could escort civilian cargo ships through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Oil and cargo ships are growing targets in war with Iran.
Turkey Says NATO Defenses Shot Down a Third Iranian Missile
item.summary: Turkey did not say where the missile was intercepted. But residents near Incirlik Air Base, which hosts U.S. troops, reported hearing sirens and a loud boom.
